Enabled.Name: Enable animations
Enabled.Hint: Master switch. Crucible's own "Enable VFX" setting is always respected as well.

Density.Name: Animation density
Density.Standard: Standard — restrained, matches Crucible's own style
Density.Full: Full — every action (not implemented in V1)

Volume.Name: Sound volume
Volume.Hint: Volume for sounds played by this module.

Shake.Name: Impact shake
Shake.Hint: Shake the target sprite on critical hits.

Debug.Name: Debug logging
Debug.Hint: Print action snapshots, resolved plans and asset fallback warnings to the console.

Preview.Title: Animation preview
Preview.Disabled: Animations are turned off in settings; the preview macro will not play anything.
